title: I think more people experience this phenomenon but they aren't aware of it because their dreams don't recur or they don't remember it.

classification.theory_summary: Speculates that many more people may have Mall World-type dreams but do not notice/connect them due to low recurrence or poor dream recall.
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream scene(s) described; only frequency/recall and that others have 'mallworld dreams (to the T)'.

meta.author_theory: More people experience Mall World-like dreams, but many don't recognize the pattern because their dreams don't recur often or they don't remember them well.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological content is limited to recurrence/recall frequency across people (author: daily/several times a week; mom/partner: ~once per year; boyfriend: partial recall). No location qualities, sensory details, entities, or events described.
